answer: Because the quartz decay is applied at each close, the whisper audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the canyon fee to keep them eligible. A juror that skips cases loses 10% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A 143 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
